experiment_design.goal: Show that MEMO Top-3 can change after realtime 3-minute windows when the observed app sequence changes sharply.
experiment_design.windowing: Three full 3-minute realtime windows: network/browser, camera/photo, then media/communication.
experiment_design.realtime_overlap: Collection does not pause for MAPLE. After each 3-minute window is structured, MAPLE inference and ActionExecutor run on a background executor while the next window keeps collecting app/eBPF/system evidence.
experiment_design.bounded_runtime: The experiment uses one collection flow and one MAPLE worker. It never creates one thread per window; raw traces stay on disk and MAPLE receives compressed window evidence plus bounded EMA memory.
experiment_design.evidence_balance: Network, Binder, Camera, Media, Display and related user-facing evidence caps are kept at the same scale before MAPLE scenario construction.
experiment_design.transparency: Each phase stores the exact MAPLE scenario/prompt input and raw MAPLE output, plus inference latency.
experiment_design.extreme_condition: Each phase repeatedly launches apps from a different user-facing category so app timeline and eBPF evidence are deliberately dominated by one behavior class.
